econometric_drivers.title: Trans-Pacific Product Tankers, Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS) & Apra Harbor Logistics
econometric_drivers.description: Guam is an isolated Western Pacific island economy completely decoupled from the North American domestic pipeline and refining grid. 100% of finished motor gasoline is imported via Medium Range (MR) product tankers originating from Asian refining hubs (Singapore, South Korea, Japan) or under Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Energy bulk supply contracts. Wholesale acquisition costs track Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS) 92/95 RON Mogas rather than US Gulf Coast RBOB, loaded with trans-Pacific clean tanker freight charters, demurrage risk, and Cabras Island terminal throughput fees.

refining_logistics.title: Cabras Island Commercial Fuel Pier & Asian Product Tanker Supply Lines
refining_logistics.description: Guam has no indigenous crude refining capacity. Refined motor gasoline is discharged at the Cabras Island commercial petroleum terminal in Apra Harbor into bulk storage tanks operated by Mobil Oil Guam, IP&E (Shell), and South Pacific Petroleum Corp (76). Ocean tanker voyages from Singapore and South Korea require 8 to 14 days transit across the Philippine Sea.

tax_structure.title: Guam Liquid Fuel Tax & Public Transit Surcharge
tax_structure.description: Guam territorial motor fuel tax consists of the baseline Liquid Fuel Tax ($0.150/gal) plus the statutory Mass Transit surcharge ($0.040/gal), creating a total territorial tax burden of $0.190/gal, plus Federal excise ($0.184/gal) for a combined tax burden of $0.374/gal.
tax_structure.notes: Guam Liquid Fuel Tax of $0.150/gal plus $0.040/gal Mass Transit surcharge ($0.190/gal territorial total). Exempt from Jones Act U.S.-build requirement under 48 U.S.C. § 1421r.

infrastructure_delivery.title: Apra Harbor Terminal Throughput & Asian MR Tanker Freight Charter
infrastructure_delivery.description: Wholesale rack prices reflect Asian MOPS Mogas spot pricing, clean product tanker Worldscale freight rates, bunker fuel adjustment factors, and Apra Harbor port throughput fees.

shock_scenarios.name: Super Typhoon Apra Harbor Port Lockdown
shock_scenarios.subtitle: Category 5 Typhoon Forces Port of Guam Closure and Tanker Holds
shock_scenarios.description: Western Pacific super typhoon approaches the Mariana Islands; US Coast Guard sets Port Condition Zulu, shutting Apra Harbor to commercial tanker traffic and sparking islandwide panic buying.

shock_scenarios.name: Singapore / South Korea Refinery Outage Spikes MOPS Benchmark
shock_scenarios.subtitle: Asian Refining Disruption Drives Up Mogas 92 RON Landed Costs
shock_scenarios.description: Unplanned flasher or FCC outages at Singapore Jurong or South Korean refining complexes elevate MOPS spot acquisition costs for Western Pacific product importers.

shock_scenarios.name: Clean Product Tanker Freight Rate Surge
shock_scenarios.subtitle: Trans-Pacific MR Tanker Charter Shortage Increases Freight Premium
shock_scenarios.description: Rising Pacific dirty/clean tanker rates and marine bunker fuel costs expand the landed freight surcharge on shipments from East Asia to Apra Harbor.
